The '''Relgim sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], bordering [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]]. The sector could be reached from [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].

==History==
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Relgim [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was overseen by [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] [[Denn Wessex]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]] was assigned to the Relgim sector where he commanded a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], including his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']].<ref name="Starfall">[[Starfall (adventure)|''Starfall'']]</ref>
